data.title: Generate isomorphic/index.html from isomorphic/BRANDING.md (brand-page) and map a viewport bucket

data.body: Review (in-session; session config forbids spawning agents unprompted). Rendered isomorphic/index.html + style.css against BRANDING.md and the plan. Verified with headless-Chrome screenshots at 1440, 390 and 320 (via iframe harness — headless clamps windows to 500px wide, which produced misleading cropped screenshots until worked around). Brief's own test battery: grep shows zero perspective/blur/rotate3d/position:fixed; border-radius only on ground ellipses/canopies/lamps (all circles, permitted by §3.1); keyframes prefixed isomorphic-; no ids at all; @import first line with ; percent-encoded per the updated root contract; html never targeted; site owns its scroll container per the new no-page-scroll contract note. DOM runs back-to-front; labelled buildings are the only interactive elements (anchor pointer-events none, faces auto). Deviations from brief, all licensed by it: RESUME dropped (no link exists in repo; brief says drop it), TWITTER widened 1x1 to 1x2 (§4: building gets wider, type never smaller), water tower moved (7,7)->(8.4,6) because at (7,7) it fully occluded EMAIL's sign (§6: props never touch signs). LinkedIn URL is a GUESSED placeholder /in/forrestalmasi — needs the real slug. Fixed during iteration: billboard skew-rise compensation, tree reading as a hole on GITHUB's wall, car starting off the road tip, mobile center-crop. node build.js run to confirm root output unchanged (isomorphic not yet mapped — user to pick a bucket). Meets acceptance criteria; done.
